nodes.label: lib_translate library target (Swift on Apple, header-only interface elsewhere)
nodes.rationale: On Apple platforms without DESKTOP_APP_DISABLE_SWIFT6, lib_translate compiles a Swift provider (translate_provider_mac_swift.swift) against Apple's Foundation/NaturalLanguage/Translation frameworks for on-device ML translation; otherwise it degrades to a plain INTERFACE library, so the rest of the desktop app builds without a Swift toolchain requirement on non-Apple platforms or when Swift is explicitly disabled.
